messages:
customer_alex: Hey team — starting ~2026-03-17T10:40:00Z a handful of customers report 502s from the hosted embeddings endpoint when doing multipart uploads (files ~7-12MB). Repro locally with curl; response headers include trace id `trace-0a1b2c`. No obvious errors in app side logs. Can someone triage?

support_liz: Thanks — can you paste an example request and the full response headers? Also which region/cluster and whether the requests use guest API keys or customer-managed keys? :eyes:

customer_alex: Using hosted region us-west-2, guest keys, endpoint POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings with multipart/form-data. Sample curl:```bash
curl -v -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer guest_XXXXX' \
  -F 'file=@large_sample.bin' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings'
```
Response snippet:```
HTTP/2 502
content-length: 0
via: 1.1 envoy
x-request-id: trace-0a1b2c
server: openresty
```

sre_omar: I pulled the trace id — on the edge logs I'm seeing upstream reset from envoy: `upstream_reset_before_response` and a pattern of h2 stream errors during the same minute. There's also a short spike in auth-cache-miss rate at 10:40. Could be auth backend throttling causing stream resets when body is streamed.

eng_june: Related note — multipart uploads open long-lived streams, if auth validation path stalls we can hit Envoy HTTP/2 stream limits and window exhaustion. Also saw an increase in our ingress concurrency metric for that host.

support_liz: Customer reports it happens intermittently when they batch a few uploads concurrently (3-6). Single upload usually succeeds.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 502 spike detected on cluster us-west-2 (ingress): 10:40:00Z - 10:45:00Z, +420% compared to baseline. Threshold: 50 requests/min.

sre_omar: Quick repro steps I used:
1) Run 3 parallel curls uploading the same 8MB file.
2) Observe ~1/3 requests return 502 with upstream_reset.

Commands:```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer guest_XXXXX' -F 'file=@large_sample.bin' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' &
done; wait
```

eng_june: From edge config: we have HTTP/2 concurrent streams per connection = 100, window initial size default. But upstream auth-cache TTL is 30s and our auth backend responded slower (~200-400ms) at spike time. Combination of concurrent streaming + auth backpressure will cause envoy to reset streams if upstream stalls.

support_liz: Customer is asking for a mitigation ASAP — what can we do to reduce customer impact while root cause is investigated?

sre_omar: Short term mitigations:
- Patch edge to increase `max_concurrent_streams` and slightly bump `initial_window_size` (low-risk).
- Add ingress rule to limit concurrent uploads per source IP (rate limit) to reduce head-of-line pressure.
- Temporarily route guest keys to a fallback auth cache (cold cache fallback) that is less strict, to avoid auth backend round trips for every stream.

eng_june: Also recommend enabling chunked upload guidance for customers (split into smaller pieces and upload sequentially) — we can provide a quick doc snippet.

support_liz: Customer wants repro steps so they can test. Can you provide an example that reliably reproduces?

sre_omar: Repro we used (bash):```bash
# spawn 6 concurrent uploads to surface the failure reliably
for i in $(seq 6); do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer guest_XXXXX' \
    -F 'file=@large_sample.bin' \
    'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' &
done; wait
```
Expect ~30-50% 502s when run during a spike.

customer_alex: Confirmed — when I run the 6-parallel test I see 1-3 failures. Any ETA on the short-term change?

eng_june: I'll open a hotfix PR to edge config to bump the h2 window and increase stream concurrency thresholds. If accepted we can roll to us-west-2 in ~45m. I'll also add a temporary circuit-breaker tweak to reduce failed upstream resets.

support_liz: I'll message the customer with the repro we used + mitigation suggestion: reduce parallel uploads to 2, or upload smaller chunks, and note we're pushing an edge config patch. :thumbsup:

sre_omar: For the postmortem/root cause: log correlation looks like auth-cache-thundering combined with multiplexed h2 streams for multipart bodies. We'll add more telemetry on auth RPC latency and track per-stream resets.

oncall-bot: Deployment started for edge-config-hotfix-2026-03-17T11:20Z to us-west-2 by eng_june.

eng_june: Patch merged and rolling. I'll follow up when rollback/finish.

support_liz: Thanks all — I'll keep the customer updated and ask them to try the load test again after the roll completes.

sre_omar: Follow-up notes for next steps: increase auth cache TTL for guest keys from 30s -> 120s for burst-prone customers, add ingress rate limiting by API key, and create an owner story to support chunked-upload SDK helpers.

customer_alex: Appreciate the quick triage. Will re-test once you announce the roll. :pray:
